fields.constructive_status: classical-only (smoothness of the real implicit-Euler update Phi via the implicit function theorem, required to even write T_D(Phi); plus unrestricted quantification over undefined 'admissible F'). Core sufficiency direction is constructive: finite-dimensional W_D, polynomial identity, terminating nilpotent Neumann series for the W_D-side solve.
fields.risk: Convention (a) makes W_D a single Weil algebra, so commutation is functoriality of the Weil functor applied to a composite that M is DEFINED to be built from: the distinct-D_i hypothesis does no work, and the sought 'structural property' is the admissibility hypothesis restated (near-circular). The test family has no negative control, so necessity is unreachable by construction.
